resumen: Reserva: sábado 26 de septiembre a las 9:00, Dra. Elena Ortiz, Arenal Centro

eventos.texto: Good afternoon, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hi, which of your sites is open on Saturdays?
Pregunta fuera del guion: contesta el Sistema 2 con el catálogo delante
Arenal Centro is the only site open on Saturdays, from 09:00 to 14:00. Of course. What can I do for you today?
Then I'd like a GP appointment on Saturday morning at that site, please.
Entiende cuándo la quiere: sábado 26 de septiembre
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Mario Garcia Lopez. My DNI is 39••••38.
Ficha encontrada: Mario G. (por DNI y nombre)
Ofrece el sábado 26 de septiembre a las 9:00 con la Dra. Elena Ortiz en Arenal Centro
Thank you, Mario, I have your record here. The earliest I have in the morning is Saturday the 26th of September at 9 am with Dra. Elena Ortiz at Arenal Centro. Shall I book that for you?
Reserva · sábado 26 de septiembre, 9:00 · Dra. Elena Ortiz · Arenal Centro
That's booked: Saturday the 26th of September at 9 am with Dra. Elena Ortiz at Arenal Centro. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
